title: Council Decision (CFSP) 2026/2554 of 16 November 2026 amending Decision (CFSP) 2023/2682 on an assistance measure under the European Peace Facility to support military actors and navies of coastal states involved in maritime security operations in the Gulf of Guinea

paras.text: Official Journal of the European Union
EN L series

sections.heading: amending Decision (CFSP) 2023/2682 on an assistance measure under the European Peace Facility to support military actors and navies of coastal states involved in maritime security operations in the Gulf of Guinea

paras.text: THE COUNCIL OF THE EUROPEAN UNION,
paras.loc: amending Decision (CFSP) 2023/2682 on an assistance measure under the European P, para 1

paras.text: Having regard to the Treaty on European Union, and in particular Article 28(1) and Article 41(2) thereof,
paras.loc: amending Decision (CFSP) 2023/2682 on an assistance measure under the European P, para 2

paras.text: Having regard to the proposal from the High Representative of the Union for Foreign Affairs and Security Policy,
paras.loc: amending Decision (CFSP) 2023/2682 on an assistance measure under the European P, para 3

paras.text: Whereas:
paras.loc: amending Decision (CFSP) 2023/2682 on an assistance measure under the European P, para 4
amending Decision (CFSP) 2023/2682 on an assistance measure under the European P, para 5

paras.text: On 27 November 2023, the Council adopted Decision (CFSP) 2023/2682 ( 1 ) , establishing an assistance measure under the European Peace Facility (EPF) to support military actors and navies of coastal states involved in maritime security operations in the Gulf of Guinea (GoG), with a financial reference amount of EUR 21 000 000.
paras.loc: amending Decision (CFSP) 2023/2682 on an assistance measure under the European P, para 6
amending Decision (CFSP) 2023/2682 on an assistance measure under the European P, para 7

paras.text: On 28 May 2026, the Political and Security Committee supported the intended reallocation of available funds in the EPF assistance measures pillar in 2026, including the increase of EUR 10 000 000 in the financial reference amount intended to cover the expenditure related to the regional assistance measure in support of maritime security in the Gulf of Guinea.
paras.loc: amending Decision (CFSP) 2023/2682 on an assistance measure under the European P, para 8
amending Decision (CFSP) 2023/2682 on an assistance measure under the European P, para 9

paras.text: Decision (CFSP) 2023/2682 should therefore be amended accordingly,
paras.loc: amending Decision (CFSP) 2023/2682 on an assistance measure under the European P, para 10

paras.text: HAS ADOPTED THIS DECISION:
paras.loc: amending Decision (CFSP) 2023/2682 on an assistance measure under the European P, para 11

paras.text: Decision (CFSP) 2023/2682 is amended as follows:

Article 1 is amended as follows: (a) in paragraph 3, point (a) is replaced by the following: ‘(a) provision of Intelligence, Surveillance and Reconnaissance (ISR) services via a manned aerial asset, for a period of two years; the National Maritime Operations Centre of the Cameroon navy of Douala shall be responsible for receiving, further processing, and sharing the ISR information with the other regional centres and maritime coordination centres of the Yaoundé Architecture via the Yaoundé Architecture Regional Information System;’ ; (b) paragraph 4 is replaced by the following: ‘4. The duration of the assistance measure shall be 67 months from the date of adoption of this Decision.’ ;

in paragraph 3, point (a) is replaced by the following: ‘(a) provision of Intelligence, Surveillance and Reconnaissance (ISR) services via a manned aerial asset, for a period of two years; the National Maritime Operations Centre of the Cameroon navy of Douala shall be responsible for receiving, further processing, and sharing the ISR information with the other regional centres and maritime coordination centres of the Yaoundé Architecture via the Yaoundé Architecture Regional Information System;’ ;

provision of Intelligence, Surveillance and Reconnaissance (ISR) services via a manned aerial asset, for a period of two years; the National Maritime Operations Centre of the Cameroon navy of Douala shall be responsible for receiving, further processing, and sharing the ISR information with the other regional centres and maritime coordination centres of the Yaoundé Architecture via the Yaoundé Architecture Regional Information System;’
paragraph 4 is replaced by the following: ‘4. The duration of the assistance measure shall be 67 months from the date of adoption of this Decision.’ ;
in Article 2, paragraph 1 is replaced by the following: ‘1. The financial reference amount intended to cover the expenditure related to the assistance measure shall be EUR 31 000 000.’.
This Decision shall enter into force on the date of its adoption.
Done at Brussels, 16 November 2026.
For the Council
The President
K. KALLAS
